metadata.description: Original agent tools by Luke: per-project handoff memory, read-only ask mode, a modularize command, an Obsidian vault bootstrap and an OpenCode hooks bridge. No dependencies.

plugins.name: agent-handoff
plugins.description: Per-project agent memory and handoff that any harness can pick up. No dependencies.

plugins.name: ask
plugins.description: /ask: a read-only question-and-answer mode that never changes anything.

plugins.name: modularize
plugins.description: /modularize <function>: refactor one function into small documented helpers, keeping its behavior.

plugins.name: vault-bootstrap
plugins.description: Turns a project folder into an Obsidian vault on the first session. No dependencies.

plugins.name: opencode-hooks-bridge
plugins.description: Runs Claude-style command hooks from OpenCode events (OpenCode plugin file; copy it into place).
